findings.title: Extra Postgres load on default MCP thread list/search
findings.failure: Every MCP getThreads (default first: 10) and searchThreads (default first: 50) call now resolves serviceLevelAgreementStatusSummary per thread; for threads with a tier or SLA policy the resolver batches serviceLevelAgreementTrackerDataLoader → getLatestServiceLevelAgreementTrackersByThreadIdsUnsafe, adding at least one tracker query per request on a path that previously skipped SLA resolution entirely.
findings.fix: Confirm acceptable load for typical MCP traffic (or document rate limits); no code change required if within SLOs.
findings.evidence: Diff adds serviceLevelAgreementStatusSummary to list/search operations; resolver at packages/core-graphql/src/resolvers.ts:7761–7776 calls serviceLevelAgreementStatusResolver; dataloader at packages/core-graphql/src/coreGraphqlDataloader.ts:898–922 batches getLatestServiceLevelAgreementTrackersByThreadIdsUnsafe.

checked_fine: Deploy: diff touches only services/mcp-server/operations/*.graphql; Dockerfile COPY operations/ — MCP container image redeploy only; no migrations, SST, OpenTofu, env vars, or permissions changes.

Deploy: entrypoint fetches live schema from MCP_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT; serviceLevelAgreementStatusSummary and ServiceLevelAgreementFilter already exist in packages/core-graphql/src/schema.ts at HEAD (unchanged vs HEAD~1).

Contract: GraphQL selection sets match schema types/unions (ServiceLevelAgreementStatusDetail*, enums ServiceLevelAgreementStatus/Type); additive response fields and optional $slaStatuses/$slaTypes variables — no route, auth, or event schema changes.

Contract: getThreads passes serviceLevelAgreements { statuses, types } with null defaults; threadDbFilterUtils.ts:647–686 adds no EXISTS clause when types, statuses, and updatedAt are all null — parity with omitting the filter (HEAD~1 behavior).
Data: no deletes, retention, or migration changes.
Silent regression: no removed validation, logging, alarms, or infra triggers in diff; new SLA fields are intentional additive behavior.
Operability: inline serviceLevelAgreements object on every getThreads call is structurally always present but DB-no-op when null; surveyResponse uses the same optional-variable pattern.
Rollback: reverting HEAD restores prior MCP operations only; core GraphQL API and data unchanged — no one-way doors.
Blast radius: no shared TS/constants edits; impact limited to MCP tool payloads and optional getThreads filters.
Dead-code: repo search for serviceLevelAgreementStatusSummary in services/mcp-server — only the three changed operation files; no new unreachable exports.

Design: SLA filter vs summary semantics (historical tracker rows vs DISTINCT ON latest per type) documented in getThreads.graphql header comments; matches serviceLevelAgreementTrackerDb.ts:151–155 vs filter EXISTS on service_level_agreement_trackers.
